WITH per_order_item AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_item_id,
    AVG(1.0 * ili.product_price / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS average_ratio,
    COUNT(ili.invoice_number) AS invoice_line_item_count
  FROM Order_Items AS oi
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_item_id
)
SELECT
  AVG(average_ratio) AS overall_average_per_item_ratio,
  AVG(invoice_line_item_count) AS average_invoice_line_items_per_order_item
FROM per_order_item;

assumptions.assumption: Includes every order item, including those with no invoice line items; those items count as zero invoice line items and have no ratio to contribute to the overall ratio average.
